availability: Free developer preview · requires Notifications-enabled Ledge
description: Mirror visible macOS notification banners in an expanded notch card. Messages wrap and long text scrolls. Dismiss the card or click away when finished. Turn the add-on on and allow Accessibility on its settings page; message text is off until you turn it on. Keep native macOS banners enabled. Text stays on this Mac. This experimental adapter does not read notification history, recover hidden previews, suppress native banners, or support inline replies. Requires the updated Ledge host with notification-banners support; older hosts cannot install this package. Store media are illustrative examples, not captures of private notifications.
